name: Discipline interface issue register
summary: After a coordination meeting exposes conflicts between disciplines, the design coordinator gets one register: each conflict from the minutes, linked to the clash-export rows and model revisions involved, with the lead who owns each system and the decision still needed. Nothing is resolved.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of the work of turning a coordination meeting's conflicts into an interface-issue register: each conflict taken from the minutes, linked to clash-export rows and model revisions, tied to the lead who owns each system, with the decision still needed and nothing resolved, proposed or checked in a model.
